grammar_focus: 现在完成时(续)· up to now/so far 信号词 · a great many+可数复数 · since+时间点/从句 · 短暂动词不接一段时间 · 现在完成时↔一般过去时对话切换
scene: 叔叔 Jack 开第二家书店装不上电话 · 买十只鸽子在两店间送信 · 办起私人'鸽子邮递'业务

grammar_card.title: 现在完成时(续):说'到现在为止' & 报新闻
grammar_card.intro: L4 学了现在完成时的构成,本课讲它的三个常用场合。全用本课句子举例。

rows: up to now / so far / lately(到目前为止 / 最近)是现在完成时的信号词
Up to now, Jack has sent many messages.
a great many + 可数名词复数(许多),只修饰可数复数
He has sent a great many requests.
报'新消息'常用现在完成时开头,只讲事情本身、不点过去具体时间
He has just bought ten pigeons!
short 动词(buy/open/start…)的完成时不接'一段时间';要说多久用 for/since 得配否定或延续动词
He hasn't lost a message since he started.(否定可表持续)

specialRules.rule: 一旦追问'什么时候'等过去具体情况,就从现在完成时改用一般过去时(—Have you seen it? —Yes. —When did you see it?)
有明确过去时间(last month / yesterday)只能用一般过去时,不能用现在完成时

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What has Jack bought to send messages?

passage: My uncle Jack has owned a small bookstore downtown for years. Last month he opened a second store across the river. The new store is only two miles away. But the phone company hasn't installed a phone line yet. So my uncle has come up with a clever idea. He has just bought ten pigeons! Yesterday, one pigeon carried his first note from the new store to the old one. The little bird covered the distance in just four minutes. Up to now, Jack has sent a great many requests and messages from one store to the other. He has never lost a single message. In this way, he has started his own private "pigeon mail" service.
